tips.compact.auto-label: Auto-compaction: starts when the usable context is this full · how much of it is kept verbatim after the cut.
tips.compact.policy: Compaction policy for THIS session: when it starts and where it lands.
tips.compact.run: Summarize the older turns and move them out of the context window. The transcript keeps them, readable and searchable.
tips.compact.target-default: Back to the derived default: an eighth of the trigger.
tips.controls.toggle: Collapse or expand the Window, Sampling, Parallel and Loop Guard cards. The ask box and the metrics stay visible.
tips.help.toggle: Interactive help: every control that has an explanation shows it — the card on hover, the question mark on inert text. Off, the panel stops teaching; this switch keeps answering.
tips.home.openFolder: Choose a folder and open it as the workspace.
tips.home.rowNoFolder: This session's folder is not available: pick another one — the session opens there.
tips.home.rowOpen: Open this session — this window switches to {folder} first (it reloads).
tips.input.attach: Attach files or images to the next message.
tips.insert.queue: Queue: the next message runs after the current run ends.
tips.insert.queueActive: Queue: the next message runs after the current run ends — hold Ctrl/Cmd to Steer.
tips.insert.steer: Steer: the next message is injected into the running loop.
tips.lg.level.high: High: flags loops sooner — more nudges, lower thresholds.
tips.lg.level.low: Low: only clear, sustained loops are flagged.
tips.lg.level.medium: Medium: the default preset — balanced nudges and thresholds.
tips.lg.level.off: Off: the guard does nothing at all — no detection, no nudges, no stop, and no tool-call deduplication (identical calls are re-run).
tips.lg.p.answerMinTokens: Minimum answer tokens before the final-answer repetition check runs (needs “Include response”). Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.p.answerThreshold: How repetitive the final answer must be to be flagged. Lower = flags sooner. Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.p.crossTurnMinLength: Minimum reasoning characters before the across-turn similarity check runs. Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.p.crossTurnSimilarity: Across turns: how similar two turns' reasoning must be to inject a corrective nudge. Lower = flags sooner. Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.p.errorStreakTurns: Consecutive turns with tool errors before the host injects a “change strategy” summary. Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.p.maxNudges: How many corrective nudges a loop type gets before the guard stops the run. Higher = more patient. Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.p.reasoningMinTokens: Minimum reasoning tokens before the within-turn repetition check runs. Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.p.reasoningThreshold: Within a turn: how repetitive the reasoning must be to be cut (trigram duplication). Lower = flags sooner. Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.p.toolFailureRepeats: How many identical FAILING tool calls are re-run before the recorded failure is returned instead. Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.p.toolRepeatConsecutive: Consecutive identical successful calls that count as a loop — the call is then served from cache. Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.p.toolRepeatWindow: Sliding window, in calls, used to count repeated call signatures. Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.p.toolRepeatWindowThreshold: Repeats of the SAME call inside the window that count as a loop. Range {min}–{max}.
tips.lg.response: Also watch the final answer text for repetition — the model repeating its own response. Off by default.
tips.locked.gear: Saving is blocked while this session works — the run keeps the model it started with.
tips.locked.mcp: Stop the run first — saving a server reconnects it and swaps the tool list mid-turn.
tips.marker.mode.analyze: This turn ran in Analyze: read-only, changes were prepared as previews.
tips.marker.mode.build: This turn ran in Build: tools wrote for real.
tips.marker.summary: Scroll to the summary that now opens the context window.
tips.marker.system: Inserted by Harny (system) — not typed by you.
tips.mcp.configure: Configure MCP servers (tool providers) this workspace can use.
tips.mcp.enabled: A disabled server keeps its config and its tools stay out of reach: nothing is connected.
tips.mcp.switchBusy: Stop the run first — a mid-run toggle only lands on the next turn.
tips.mcp.switchNotInstalled: Not installed or enabled in the config: turn it on there first.
tips.mcp.switchUse: Use {name} in this session: installing is global, using it is per conversation.
tips.mcp.toggleOff: Click to disable this server in this session.
tips.mcp.toggleOn: Click to enable this server in this session.
tips.mcp.toolsPick: Choose which of this server's tools the model sees.
tips.mcp.toolsPickSome: {hidden} of {total} tool(s) switched off in this session — click to choose.
tips.message.branch: Branch the session from this point: everything up to and including this reply.
tips.message.cut: Cut the conversation from here down: this message and everything after it.
tips.metrics.cache: Input tokens served from the prompt cache (cheaper and faster).
tips.metrics.cacheRead: Input tokens served from the prompt cache: {cached} ({saved}%).
tips.metrics.cacheReadWrite: Input tokens served from the prompt cache: {cached} ({saved}%), and {written} written to it.
tips.metrics.cacheUnknown: This provider does not report cached input tokens.
tips.metrics.cacheWrite: Tokens written into the prompt cache: {written}.
tips.metrics.ctx: {window} context window − {reserve} reserved for the response = {usable} usable tokens.
tips.metrics.tokens: Input tokens used in this context window.
tips.metrics.tokensExact: Exactly {used} input tokens in this context.
tips.mode.analyze: Analyze: read-only — it inspects but never modifies files.
tips.mode.build: Build: full tool use — create, modify and run (files, shell, search).
tips.mode.locked: {wanted} — applies to the NEXT run: this one is still {running}. Stop to stop now.
tips.mode.lockedRun: {running} — locked to this run: a switch now applies to the NEXT one. Stop to stop now.
tips.mode.summary: Analyze is read-only: it inspects and plans. Build has full tool use: it creates, modifies and runs.
tips.mode.untrusted: Restricted Mode: this folder is not trusted, so Harny does not write files or run commands here (Analyze only). Trust the folder to enable Build.
tips.model.current: Switch model — this session is running on {model}.
tips.model.select: Pick the model this session runs on.
tips.model.warn: models.dev unreachable — some model limits may be unknown.
tips.parallel.locked: Parallel {wanted} — applies to the NEXT run: this one is still {running}. Stop to stop now.
tips.parallel.lockedRun: Parallel {running} — locked to this run: a switch now applies to the NEXT one. Stop to stop now.
tips.parallel.toggle: Parallel: let the agent launch sub-agents alongside it (read-only in Analyze).
tips.param.ctxWindow: How much of the conversation the model can hold at once — the window compaction keeps clear. Bigger means more room, and more work per turn.
tips.param.frequency: Penalises a word by HOW OFTEN it already appeared — a stronger brake than presence on repeated words.
tips.param.outputTokens: The ceiling for ONE reply, not how much the model will write: past it the answer is cut off.
tips.param.parallel: How many sub-agents the agent may run at the same time. In Analyze they are read-only, so the cap is real there too.
tips.param.presence: Pushes the model away from anything it already wrote — a brake on coming back to the same words.
tips.param.sensitivity: How eagerly the guard flags a loop: preset thresholds. Off turns detection off entirely.
tips.param.temperature: Randomness: higher explores more, lower repeats itself more. The sampler sent under this name.
tips.param.thinking: How much reasoning the model may spend before it answers — per session.
tips.param.topP: Nucleus sampling: keep the likeliest tokens until their probability adds up to this. The other way to steer the same knob.
tips.pending.head: Messages you typed while the session works: queued messages run after this turn, steered ones change it.
tips.pending.toQueue: Deliver it after the run: it waits in the queue with the other messages.
tips.pending.toSteer: Deliver it first: injected into the running loop at its next step.
tips.providers.export: Export the providers config to a JSON file.
tips.providers.import: Import providers from a JSON file (merged into the current config).
tips.providers.session-header: Header carrying this conversation's stable session id (routing + prompt cache, e.g. OpenCode Go).
tips.sampler.auto.freq: Reset to Auto: the value is not sent, so the model uses its own default.
tips.sampler.auto.presence: Reset to Auto: the value is not sent, so the model uses its own default.
tips.sampler.auto.samp: Reset to Auto: the value is not sent, so the model uses its own default.
tips.sampler.thinking.off: No reasoning effort sent: the model's own default.
tips.sessionEditor.move: Open this session in another folder — picking one re-points it, and it opens there.
tips.sessionEditor.openHere: Open this session — it already lives in this folder, so nothing reloads.
tips.sessionEditor.openOther: Open this session — this window switches to its folder first (it reloads).
tips.sessionEditor.pickFolder: Pick the folder this session should live in — the session opens right after.
tips.sessions.folderGone: This session's folder no longer exists — click to pick another one.
tips.sessions.foreignNoFolder: Open, created outside a workspace folder.
tips.sessions.locked.branch: Session is working — stop it before branching.
tips.sessions.locked.delete: Session is working — stop it before deleting.
tips.sessions.locked.rename: Session is working — stop it before renaming.
tips.sessions.manage: Manage all sessions (every folder) — including the ones you have not opened.
tips.sessions.manageBusy: Manage every session — the working ones are locked.
tips.sessions.new: Start a new conversation in this folder.
tips.sessions.vacuum-live: These two sliders are global settings: they are stored as soon as you move them, so this card needs no Save.
tips.subagent.parallel: May run in parallel with the other read-only sub-agents.
tips.tabs.folderGone: This session's folder no longer exists: the transcript opens, but the agent has nowhere to work.
tips.tabs.locked.close: Session is working — stop it before closing the tab.
tips.thinking.unsupported: This provider/model does not declare thinking control (add "thinking": "bool", "effort" or "type" to its config entry).
tips.tools.all: Include every tool of this server.
tips.tools.analyzeInert: Hidden from the model, so there is nothing to allow in Analyze — switch the tool on first.
tips.tools.analyzeInherited: The server declares every tool of it read-only: this one runs in Analyze by the server's statement, not this conversation's.
tips.tools.analyzeOff: Refused in Analyze: it may modify resources, and an external call cannot be previewed. Click to declare it read-only.
tips.tools.analyzeOn: Runs in Analyze: this conversation declares it read-only. Click to take it back.
tips.tools.exposed: The model can call this tool in this conversation.
tips.tools.hidden: Hidden: the model does not see this tool in this conversation.
tips.tools.legend: Left: the model sees the tool · Analyze: it may run read-only · both for this conversation only.
tips.tools.none: Expose no tool of this server.
tips.tools.save: Apply to this conversation: which tools the model sees, and which run in Analyze.
tips.transcript.collapse: Fold every expanded section — thinking, tool calls, sub-agents — back to one line.
tips.transcript.follow: Jump to the newest message and keep following the stream as it arrives.
